title: autoresearch target (D32): two loops through four layers
subtitle: The outer loop runs left to right, one round after another; the shaded inner loop runs once per experiment, several at a time. Red borders: points that can refuse. Dashed purple: not built yet. Today's system: architecture.svg.

spans.label: inner loop: once per experiment, several in parallel (GPU and RAM slots)

file.label: plain file in the problem folder

nodes.label:
Prompt; approves
the problem
nodes.note: the person starts a round with a prompt (the filled loop prompt: stop time, permissions) and approves the problem the planner drafted

nodes.label:
Promotion: OK
and TEST once
nodes.note: the person's: a version becomes the deployed champion only with their OK and one TEST check, logged before it runs (run.py refuses otherwise)

nodes.label:
Planner
problem draft
nodes.note: new mode of the planner: drafts PROBLEM.md from the prompt; the file stays protected

nodes.label:
Researcher
scouts, summaries
nodes.note: scouts in parallel, one per topic, then a summary with its digest per problem group

nodes.label:
Planner: branches
(one per lens); critic
nodes.note: the planner writes cards once per lens, in parallel; the critic (fresh context) accepts, revises or rejects each card

nodes.label:
Planner, coder
+ critic
nodes.note: only for a block experiment (new code): detail plan naming the boxes it changes, code with its spec test, a critic pass on shared code; a variant needs no agent

nodes.label:
Planner: tracking
n best, next round
nodes.note: reads the verdicts, updates the set of n best by the written rule, proposes a promotion, plans the next branches

nodes.label:
Critic
numbers of the report
nodes.note: a fresh reviewer checks the round's report against the primary sources

nodes.label: WRITE GATE: protected truth files only with a grant under a decided D<n>; a card only when complete (G2)

experiments/<id>/
card.md + machine block
nodes.note: the round's plan: one table of branches; each card names its parent version and its decision rule

nodes.label:
runs/<arm>.<seed>/
run.json, log.jsonl
nodes.note: written by the launcher and the training; read by the train suite

nodes.label:
versions/
the n best
nodes.note: new: one registry per problem (tagged commit, config, weights, metric card per version) in place of the two formats of today

nodes.label:
START GATE
card, slot, tag
nodes.note: run.py starts a run only with a card (hypothesis, prediction, rule), a free GPU / RAM slot, the TEST split only with a logged row; it tags the code it ran

nodes.label:
the problem's
literature tools
nodes.note: no code in autoresearch/ yet; the lane problem's catalogue would move up once a second problem uses it

nodes.label:
launcher + train
suite, kill rules
nodes.note: a training is watched by code: the card's kill rules stop it; an alarm wakes the lead chat, no agent watches

nodes.label:
eval suite (VAL)
decide.py: the rule
nodes.note: numbers, pictures and ms on VAL; decide.py turns the cards into KEEP / CUT / TIE / INCONCLUSIVE by the card's written rule

nodes.label:
board, registry,
package (TEST once)
nodes.note: new in autoresearch: evalsuite package (run a version on the test set, write its results, measure ms, bundle it) and one board; today these are per-problem scripts (bev_fusion board.py; the two prototype scripts of 2026-11-01 are not committed yet)

nodes.label:
cleanup, checks
clean_temp, archdraw
nodes.note: tags the scratch and moves temp/ away, finds dead paths, checks the report's numbers, the per-round table, these drawings
